newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close steady at 21.875 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close steady at 21.875 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates closed steady on Tuesday at 21.875 percent but could rise slightly on Wednesday, traders said.
"The tax payment deadline of December 10 could result in tighter liquidity on Wednesday," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
Overnight rates opened between 22.25 and 22.50 percent but quickly eased to a range of 21.75 and 22.0 percent in a slightly more active market than Monday's, traders said.
Traders, however, did not see significant deals on the relatively high opening levels.
The central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo rate, currently at 22.25 percent, could be the ceiling for a possible short-term rise, traders added.
